name: Pizzeria Da Giuseppe
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Da Giuseppe in Thaur** – A cozy Italian trattoria just outside **Innsbruck**, where authentic flavors meet Tyrolean charm. Savor freshly baked **Pizza Napoletana**, handmade pasta, and crispy **Calzones**, all crafted with love in a warm, rustic setting. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu**—the perfect sweet finish to your meal. Whether you’re craving a quick bite or a leisurely dinner, this hidden gem near the **Inn River** is a must-visit for pizza lovers in **Tirol**. Open daily, welcoming both locals and travelers alike. *Buon appetito!*
